== Session updates are no longer lost when database connections are slow to open

Session updates are no longer delayed or lost when new database connections are slow to open while many sessions run at the same time.

* Session state, videos, and test reports are saved reliably during periods of high session activity.
* A database connection that stops responding while it opens is abandoned and retried, so it no longer blocks session updates.
